title: Unique normalized exact shift on each direct-image stage
statement:
Fix universes u and w, a prime natural number l, and an algebraic closure Ω : Type w of ℚ_[l], with its given field and algebra structures. Let X and Y be schemes in universe u, each Noetherian and of finite topological Krull dimension, with l invertible in every stalk. Write dT and iT for the respective dimension and invertibility witnesses for each scheme T. All preservation hypotheses, functors, comparisons and conclusions are quantified exactly as follows.

theorem pbcDirectImageStageShift_exists (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (pres : ∀ (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω)
      (K : pbcIntegralStage l Ω X E),
      PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)
        ((pbcActualDerivedPush f (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj))
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) :
    ∃! s : (pbcDescentDirectImage l Ω f pres E).CommShift ℤ,
      PbcDirectImageStageShiftSpec l Ω f pres E s

The normalized shifts use the stated integral and rational operations, without a changed triangulation. Definitions are those of [def-weil-pbc-descent-interfaces], [def-per-rational-direct-image-family] and [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category].

proof.text:
the full integral subcategories inherit their triangulations from the
ambient derived categories. Ordinary right-derived direct image is exact, so
its restriction is exact by full faithfulness. The universal localization shift
is uniquely fixed by its identity integral square. Every distinguished rational
triangle is isomorphic to the image of an integral distinguished triangle.
The restriction takes that integral triangle to a distinguished triangle, and
its rational image is distinguished. The localization square identifies it
with the image under rational direct image, proving exactness. Uniqueness of
shift already follows from the normalized integral square, without any
nonvanishing or nonempty-scheme hypothesis.

split_report.summary: Unique normalized exact shift on each direct-image stage. The stage exactness theorem is proved; the comparison theorem is the remaining separate scalar-shift equation.
split_report.blueprint: The final operations paragraph uses rational exact transport and shift compatibility. Whole-blueprint searches for direct-image family and shift equations return no equivalent blueprint statement.
split_report.edge_cases: Identity morphisms, empty schemes, repeated coefficient fields, independently sized coefficient algebraic closures, and proof-irrelevant preservation witnesses keep the same statement.
